capabilities: Attach tooltips to words with inline Markdown syntax
Pick a per-tooltip style with prefix letters
Render Markdown, links and note links inside tooltips
Set default style and colors in plugin settings
Focus a trigger with Tab and close with Escape
extras: Desktop only: requires Obsidian Desktop 1.15.0 or later. Settings are stored locally; no telemetry, ads, accounts or payments. MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian has no inline way to attach a short explanation or link to a word without adding visible clutter to the note.
summary: Adds inline Markdown tooltips to words in notes, shown on hover as dotted underlines, info icons, speech bubbles or highlights.
